title: Holiday Kit
og_description: Download this package (100 assets) for free, CC0 licensed!
visual_summary: A low-poly, flat-shaded Christmas village diorama rendered in a Kenney 'mini' isometric style. Two log cabins (one small with a wreath, one larger chalet with a green gabled roof and glowing windows) sit on a dark slate ground surrounded by snow-capped pine trees, snowmen, lampposts, a decorated Christmas tree with garland and wrapped presents, a reindeer, a wooden sled, lantern clusters, and snow drifts. The palette is bright and saturated: Christmas-tree green, pure white snow, warm brown wood, red accents on gifts and bunting, golden star and lantern highlights, with cool grey rocks and pale-blue snow shadows. No textures; everything is built from clean colored polygons giving a soft, toy-like, slightly faceted cartoon look optimized for stylized holiday scenes.

zip_inventory.notes: 99 unique 3D models provided in GLB/FBX/OBJ+MTL; og_description rounds to 100.
